Name: take silence as approval
Expressions:
场景：你把一个会影响另一团队的接口变更方案发到群里，两天没人回复。项目经理说：“没人反对，就按这个做吧。”但对方负责人还没明确确认。
中文参考（非用户作答）：我不想把没有回复当作同意。我们能先请对方负责人明确确认，再开始做吗？
Equivalent:
专业版：I'd rather not take silence as approval. Could we get explicit confirmation from their lead before proceeding?
口语版：I don't want to take silence as approval. Can we check with their lead before we start?

口语版：Before I dive in, I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about this requirement.
